claims.claim: A used dry pressing iron that is still working is available for sale.
claims.evidence: The witness only shows a white electric iron and visible dirt/scuffing; no test/heating/temperature or steam/dry function verification is shown.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No receipt/date, warranty card, or condition evidence that confirms purchase timing is shown.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: No internal inspection or proof of motor condition is shown; only external marks and a worn/dirty plug area are visible.
The witness report does not show the receipt or warranty card.

risks.risk: It may not heat properly or may not reach/hold temperature (dry pressing irons can fail heater/thermostat).
risks.proof: A short video of the iron plugged in, showing power indicator (if any) and a temperature/heat test (e.g., touching a test fabric and demonstrating consistent heating) for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working; treat as potentially faulty/needs testing.

risks.risk: Thermostat/controls may be faulty or inaccurate, causing overheating or weak heating.
risks.proof: A clip showing temperature setting changes (low/medium/high) and consistent heating response (e.g., fabric test at each setting).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case control fault risk; assume unreliable temperature control.

risks.risk: Soleplate condition may be poor (scratches/pitting) affecting ironing quality and increasing likelihood of snagging/burning marks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the entire soleplate surface in good light, showing whether it is smooth or has pitting/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn with possible soleplate wear.

risks.risk: Power cord/plug may have internal damage or poor contact (worn/dirty near connection noted).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the plug and cord strain relief plus a quick continuity/plug tightness check (or a video showing stable power without flicker when moved).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher electrical risk due to worn/dirty plug area.

risks.risk: Steam/water system issues (even if sold as dry) could indicate overall poor maintenance or leaks if present.
risks.proof: Photos showing whether there is a water tank/steam holes and whether any leaks or residue are present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case maintenance issue; assume possible leak/residue even if not used.

proof_requests: Video proof it heats properly: plug in, show power, demonstrate ironing on fabric for a few minutes.
Close-up photos of the full soleplate surface (scratches/pitting) in bright light.
Photos of the plug and the full cord length, including strain relief near the iron.
Photo of the thermostat/control area and any steam/dry selector (if present).
Show the receipt and warranty card (photos of date/serial/model).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an electric dry pressing iron externally, but there is no proof it heats/works; visible dirt/scuffing and a worn/dirty plug area add electrical and performance uncertainty that prevents a confident worst-case price without a heating test.
